## Code Review: PR #9 - Missing currency Permission

File: manifest.json (permissions section)

Problem: Body PR states: 'New permission categories: currency and settings'. Code uses ctx.api.exchangeRates.getRatesForDates() but verification not performed whether manifest.json declares this category.

Evidence: validate.mjs would fail at validateDeclaredApiUsage step if permission missing. Without this, host blocks ctx.api.currency.getRatesForDates() at runtime.

Fix Required: Add to manifest.json: { "category": "currency", "purpose": "Access to historical exchange rates", "functions": ["getRatesForDates"] }

Status: BLOCKER - Cannot merge without this.
